interpretation: Unrelativized sibling of -A for the same sentence ('quae autem pluribus modis habere se possunt, possunt se habere aliter et aliter'). It keeps reading choice (a) of -A (the two-way potency of the contradictory to r is an ability to be in more than one way) and, not taking 'aliter et aliter' anaphorically, does not say in which respect the thing can be otherwise. Weaker than -A and too weak for the Lambda.7 route to pure act, which needs the respect of the potency.
